Specification: This module models heaps, objects, and promise-like objects in an object-capability style setting, including resolved and unresolved promises and actions that resolve or garbage-collect them. It defines the shape of objects, heaps, eventuals, promises, and heap well-formedness conditions such as absence of dangling pointers and acyclicity of promise chains, and it assumes semantic properties of an abstract method evaluator Eval. The file contains state-level structure definitions and three heap-updating actions for resolving when-promises, resolving non-when-promises, and garbage collecting resolved promises, but it does not define a full temporal specification or liveness/fairness properties.
AssumptionNames:
\A M \in Method, 
          obj \in OKObject,
          args \in Seq(Value \cup Id) : 
         LET E(H) == Eval(M, obj, args, H)
             UseableId(H) == ReachableWithoutPromises(obj, H) \cup 
                               UNION {ReachableWithoutPromises(args[i], H) : 
                                        i \in 1..Len(args)}
         IN  /\ \A H \in OKHeap : 
                  /\ E(H) \in [result : Value \cup Id, heap : OKHeap]
                  /\ \A id \in Id :
                        (H[id] # E(H).heap[id]) => \/ id \in UseableId(H)
                                                   \/ H[id] = << >>
             /\ \A H1, H2 \in OKHeap : 
                  /\ UseableId(H1) = UseableId(H2)
                  /\ \A id \in UseableId(H1) : H1[id] = H2[id]
                  =>  /\ E(H1).result = E(H2).result
                      /\ \A id \in Id : (H1[id] # E(H1).heap[id]) =>
                                          (E(H1).heap[id] = E(H2).heap[id])
